title: Implement @sevenpico/cdk-construct-sfn-error-notification
description:
Compose cdk-construct-sqs-queue with Step Functions to deliver error notifications to a queue. Depends on task 005 (sqs-queue) and task 012 (step-functions) being done. Read spec/construct-sfn-error-notification.md and the source Terraform module linked in the spec. GitHub issue #17.

Workflow:
1. Pattern Specialist implements: pure functions in {name}-fns.ts, thin Construct class in {name}.ts, BDD tests, package README. Verify all dependency constructs are already implemented before starting.
2. Code Reviewer signs off: JSII compliance (no union/function types, all props readonly, full re-exports), functional architecture split (no side-effects in fns.ts, no logic in construct), spec fidelity (props match Terraform vars, defaults match Terraform defaults, contextId/contextTags/isEnabled used correctly), README accuracy.
3. QA Engineer signs off: BDD scenarios cover the full composed pattern including enabled:false on the parent and each composed resource, pure function tests cover defaults/overrides/edge cases, CDK assertions verify the wiring between composed constructs.

Task is done only when all three phases are complete.
